title: Old chap
html_source: Mulligan continues his patronizing and mocking tone as he refers to God as an “Old Chap”, and asks him to switch off the “current” to his razor.

anchor.prefix:
paused awhile in rapt attention, his even white teeth glistening here and there with gold points. Chrysostomos. Two strong shrill whistles answered through the calm. 

 — Thanks,
anchor.suffix:
, he cried briskly. That will do nicely. Switch off the current, will you? 

1922#3
